Definition: from G2813; stealing (properly, the thing stolen, but used of the act):--theft.
BiblicalUsage: Klemma is theft, the thing stolen and the act of stealing. Revelation 9:21 says that even after the plagues, men repented not of their thefts, nor of their murders, nor of their sorceries, nor of their fornications.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the unrepented theft in Revelation is the mark of a hard heart: the plagues could not make them sorry for what their hands had taken.
